documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in facilities management. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The account is in the 'customer' stage with a score of 80, indicating a moderate level of engagement. The customer has provided consent and is currently experiencing an issue with their workflow after a configuration change. The inquiry highlights that this is a support incident and that expansion discussions should be deferred until the issue is resolved.

claims.quote: We are an existing customer in facilities management. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your workflow has stopped following a configuration change, and we appreciate your prompt communication. This appears to be a support incident, and we will immediately escalate it to our support team to resolve the issue. Once the workflow is restored, we can revisit any expansion discussions. In the meantime, please feel free to contact our support team directly for further assistance. We value your partnership and look forward to resolving this matter quickly.
questions: Have you already contacted the support team directly?
Is there any specific information about the configuration change that might help in diagnosing the issue?
uncertainties: The exact nature of the configuration change is not specified, which may impact the support team's ability to diagnose the issue quickly.
